metadata.title: VMFleet
metadata.description: VM Fleet is a performance characterization and analyst framework for exploring the storage capabilities of Windows Server Hyper-Converged environments with Storage Spaces Direct

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Set-FleetControlScript' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
